short_description: Login page returns 500 for SSO users
description: Affected users report a 500 error after Okta redirect. Started around 09:00 UTC. Pod logs show JWT signature verification failures after a recent rotation of the IdP signing certificate.
work_notes: Rolled back idp-config to previous version. Monitoring.

short_description: Reports dashboard slow during EOD batch
description: Finance team reports dashboard latency >30s between 17:00-18:30 IST. Correlates with the EOD reconciliation batch job running on the shared reporting DB.

short_description: S3 export job failing with AccessDenied
description: Nightly data export to s3://acme-exports/finance/ failing since 2026-05-23. KMS key policy changed during compliance review and removed the export role.
work_notes: Restored KMS key grant. Re-running failed jobs.

short_description: Email notifications not being sent from CRM
description: Sales team reports CRM stopped emailing customers after a deploy on 2026-05-24. Sendgrid API key was rotated but the secret was not updated in the CRM deployment.
work_notes: Updated secret in vault. Restarted CRM pods.

short_description: Request access to production logs (Splunk index: app_prod)
description: Requester needs read access to the app_prod Splunk index for on-call rotation. Manager approval received. Standard 90-day access.

short_description: Roll out new WAF rules to block credential stuffing
description: Add Cloudflare WAF rules targeting known credential-stuffing patterns observed against /login. Deploy first to staging, then 10% prod, then 100%.
